entities.summary: Luca Vildoza is an Argentine professional basketball player for Virtus Bologna of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA) and the EuroLeague. He also represents the Argentine national team in international competition. At 1.91 m tall, he plays at both the point guard and shooting guard positions.
